rachel: Flash poll: give me your best two-word microwave warning for office leftovers. winner gets a brag emoji :trophy:
sam: "Proceed Carefully" :grimacing:
maria: "Mystery Meal" :face_with_monocle:
jorge: "Biological Option" :sweat_smile:
noor: "Explosive Surprise" :boom: (dramatic)
mel: "Kitchen Roulette" :game_die:
sam: alliteration attempt: "Leftover Lottery"
rachel: two words only! keep it snappy :sparkles:
jorge: "Heat Responsibly"
maria: "Questionable Origins" :thinking_face:
noor: dramatic alternate: "Pandora's Lunch" :open_mouth:
mel: I vote "Explosive Surprise" for chaos :joy:
dev-bot: poll created  options: 6  react to vote
rachel: will tally at 2:30pm PT. feel free to drop last-minute zingers
sam: late entry: "Potential Regret" :flushed:
jorge: official micromemo: "May Contain Life" :scream:
maria: :laughing: that's dark but accurate
dev-bot: poll closed  winner: "Potential Regret" (3 votes) :trophy::confetti_ball:
rachel: Congrats @sam — claim your imaginary trophy and eternal office infamy. great work everyone, best 3-minute break ever :coffee:
